{{Quote|I am Lord Umbral, Master of Darkness, Imperator of Terror, Connoisseur of Suffering.|translated=1|Umbral|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Umbral''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living during the [[third Galactic War]]. At some point, Umbral established a cult known as the [[Master's Top Secret Army]] to create a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] army, having been rejected by both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.3}}</ref> the [[Alliance Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] discovered [[Umbral's hideout]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]] to put an end to his actions and uncover the secrets of the Master's Top Secret Army.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Umbral first appeared in the [[September]] [[2023]] Game Update 7.3.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Confidence in Power">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230901-0|text=Galactic Season 5 "Confidence in Power"}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
